---
title: "Meteorology and Climate"
subtitle: "Three dataset options for your EAES 380 final project"
---

### 1. [KBS Meteorology](kbs-meteorology.qmd)

*LTER Meteorological Stations at the Kellogg Biological Station, Michigan (1941–present)*

Long-term meteorological observations from the Kellogg Biological Station LTER site in southwest Michigan.

EDI package: `knb-lter-kbs.2`

### 2. [Niwot Ridge D1](niwot-ridge-d1.qmd)

*Climate Data from Niwot Ridge LTER D1 Station (High-Elevation Alpine)*

High-frequency (10-minute) climatological data from the D1 climate station on Niwot Ridge, Colorado (elevation ~3738 m).

EDI package: `knb-lter-nwt.273`

### 3. [California Downscaled Grids](california-downscaled.qmd)

*Downscaled Climate Grids of California (90 m) for Bioclimatic Variables, 1971–2000*

High-resolution (90 m) downscaled climate grids for California covering a variety of bioclimatic variables derived from historical climate data (1971–2000 normal period).

EDI package: `edi.167.1`
